# <span class="en">Geovisualisation and geocommunication</span><span class="zh">地理可视化与地理传达</span> {#sec-geocomm}

::: {.en}
The interpretation of each individual figure appears beside that figure, in the
section where its analysis is carried out. This section states the decisions
that are shared across all of them, what each family of graphic is for, how
quantities are encoded, and what the encoding cannot be asked to do. The
reasoning is set out once here instead of being repeated twenty-one times.
:::

::: {.zh}
每一幅图的具体解读,都紧贴该图放在它所属的分析章节里。这里陈述的是**跨越所有图形
的共同决策**,每一类图形各自承担什么任务、数量如何被编码,以及这套编码**不能**
被要求做到什么。把这些理由集中写在这里,好过重复二十一次。
:::

## <span class="en">Four families of graphic, four jobs</span><span class="zh">四类图形,四项任务</span>

::: {.en}
The report uses a deliberately small vocabulary. Every graphic belongs to one of
four families, and each family answers one kind of question.

**Maps** answer *where*. They carry the intensity surface (@fig-kde-main), the
district aggregation (@fig-kecamatan), the study window and its context
(@fig-studyarea), and the model residuals (@fig-parres). All are drawn in
EPSG:32749, the projection in which the analysis itself is done, so that a
distance read off a map is the distance the statistics used, the projected area
error is `r sprintf("%.2f%%", CRS_ERR_PCT)`, reported in @sec-crs.

**Envelope plots** answer *compared with what*. Every second-order figure
(@fig-lcsr, @fig-linhom, @fig-pcf, @fig-gof) plots an observed curve against a
simulated envelope, never against a theoretical line alone, because the
report's central claim is about reference models, not about statistics. The
curves are centred on the null expectation so that the deviation (not the
absolute value) is what the reader's eye measures.

**Covariate curves** answer *along what gradient*. @fig-rhohat and @fig-covecdf
express intensity as a function of distance instead of as a colour on a map,
because a monotone decline is legible in a line and invisible in a fill.

**Small multiples** answer *how much does this depend on my choice*. The
bandwidth ladder (@fig-bwladder), the null-model ladder (@fig-linhom) and the
Knox threshold grid (@fig-knox) each show the same estimate repeated across the
parameter that was chosen, so that sensitivity is shown, not asserted.
:::

::: {.zh}
图形词汇是刻意压缩过的。每一幅图都属于以下四类之一,而每一类回答一种
问题。

**地图**回答**在哪里**。它们承载强度面(@fig-kde-main)、按区聚合
(@fig-kecamatan)、研究窗口及其背景(@fig-studyarea),以及模型残差
(@fig-parres)。全部绘制于 EPSG:32749(也就是分析本身所用的投影)因此从地图上量
得的距离,就是统计量所使用的距离;投影面积误差为
`r sprintf("%.2f%%", CRS_ERR_PCT)`,详见 @sec-crs。

**包络图**回答**与什么相比**。每一幅二阶图形(@fig-lcsr、@fig-linhom、@fig-pcf、
@fig-gof)都是把观测曲线与**模拟包络**对照,而不是仅仅对照一条理论线,因为本报告的
核心论断是关于**参照模型**的,不是关于统计量的。曲线以零模型期望为中心,使读者的
眼睛度量的是**偏离**,而不是绝对值。

**协变量曲线**回答**沿着什么梯度**。@fig-rhohat 与 @fig-covecdf 把强度表达为距离
的函数,而不是地图上的一种颜色,因为单调下降在折线中一目了然,在色块填充中则不可见。

**小倍数图**回答**这有多依赖我的选择**。带宽阶梯(@fig-bwladder)、零模型阶梯
(@fig-linhom)与 Knox 阈值网格(@fig-knox),都是把同一个估计沿着**被选定的那个
参数**重复呈现,从而把敏感性**展示**出来,而不是仅仅断言。
:::

## <span class="en">What the colours mean</span><span class="zh">颜色的含义</span>

::: {.en}
Colour carries meaning in this report, and it carries only one.

Warm hues are reserved for quantities that actually represent fire. The
sequential ramp used for every density surface runs through seven stops from
`#fffbf5` to `#6b0d05`, and its lightness decreases monotonically along that
sequence. Two consequences follow, and both were the reason for building the
ramp by hand instead of accepting a default: the order of the classes survives
greyscale printing, and it survives the common forms of colour-vision
deficiency, because the reader is decoding lightness rather than hue.

Teal (`#0e7490`) is the cool counterweight and is used only for quantities that
are deliberately *not* fire, rivers, and the "distance to natural water"
covariate whose effect runs opposite to the canal effect. Structure (windows,
boundaries, gridlines, envelopes) stays in neutral greys, so that the page
furniture never competes with the data for attention. No figure in the report
encodes a variable in red against green.

Categorical encodings are always declared explicitly, never left to the
default palette, which is why `scale_*_manual` appears throughout the analysis
chunks: a category's colour is part of the argument and should not change when a
factor level is added.
:::

::: {.zh}
颜色在本报告中承载意义,而且**只承载一种**意义。

暖色专门保留给**真正代表火的量**。所有密度面所用的顺序色带,由 `#fffbf5` 到
`#6b0d05` 共七级,其**亮度沿序列单调下降**。由此得到两个后果,而这两点正是手工构造
这条色带、而非沿用默认值的原因:类别的**顺序**在灰度打印下依然成立,在常见的**色觉
缺陷**下也依然成立,因为读者解码的是亮度,而不是色相。

青色(`#0e7490`)是冷色的对位,只用于那些刻意**不是火**的量(河流,以及「到天然
水体的距离」这一效应方向与运河相反的协变量。结构性元素)窗口、边界、网格线、
包络,一律保持中性灰,使页面构件永远不与数据争夺注意力。报告中**没有任何一幅图**
用红对绿来编码变量。

分类型编码一律显式声明,而不交给默认调色板。这也是分析代码块中处处出现
`scale_*_manual` 的原因:一个类别的颜色是论证的一部分,不应在新增一个因子水平时
发生改变。
:::

## <span class="en">What the figures cannot be asked to do</span><span class="zh">这些图形不能被要求做到什么</span>

::: {.en}
Three limits are worth stating, because each of them is a place where a reader
could over-read a picture.

A density surface is a **smoothed** quantity, and the smoothing bandwidth is an
analytical choice, not a property of the fire. @fig-kde-main is drawn at
$\sigma = 2$ km; @fig-bwladder exists precisely so that the reader can see how
much of the apparent structure belongs to the kernel and not to the field. No
conclusion in this report rests on a feature visible at only one bandwidth.

A map of detections is a map of the **observation process** multiplied by the
fire field, as @sec-assumptions sets out. Bright areas on any intensity map are
places where fire was *detected* often, which is not the same as places where
fire burned most. Cloud cover and overpass geometry are part of what the colour
is showing.

Figure text is **not** switched by the EN / 中文 control. Titles, subtitles and
axis labels are drawn into the image by R at render time and cannot be
translated in the browser, so they remain in English in both language modes.
Every hand-written element around the figures (captions, interpretations, and
the alternative text that screen readers receive) is bilingual.
:::

::: {.zh}
有三条限度值得明确写出,因为每一条都是读者**可能过度解读一幅图**的地方。

密度面是一个**经过平滑**的量,而平滑带宽是一项**分析选择**,不是火本身的属性。
@fig-kde-main 绘制于 $\sigma = 2$ km;@fig-bwladder 的存在正是为了让读者看清:表观
结构中有多少来自核函数,而非来自火场。本报告**没有任何结论**建立在只在单一带宽下
才可见的特征上。

一幅探测点地图,是**观测过程**与火场相乘的结果,如 @sec-assumptions 所述。任何强度
图上的明亮区域,是火被**探测到**得更频繁的地方,这与火烧得最多的地方**并不相同**;
云覆盖与过境几何也是那种颜色所呈现内容的一部分。

**图形内部的文字不随 EN / 中文 切换。** 标题、副标题与坐标轴标签由 R 在渲染时画入
图像,无法在浏览器端翻译,因此在两种语言模式下都保持英文。图形周围一切手写元素(题注、解读,以及屏幕阅读器读到的替代文本)都是双语的。
:::
